name: runtime_open_commands_update_collision
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_open_commands_update_collision
BEFORE UPDATE ON runtime_events WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_events WHERE id=NEW.id
  AND type IN ('NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED','NATIVE_COMMAND_FINISHED','NATIVE_COMMAND_RECOVERED'))
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO runtime_open_commands_dirty
 SELECT task_id FROM runtime_events WHERE id=NEW.id
 ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO NOTHING;
 DELETE FROM runtime_open_commands WHERE start_id=NEW.id;
END

CREATE TABLE runtime_open_commands (

name: runtime_open_commands_change
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_open_commands_change
AFTER UPDATE ON runtime_events
WHEN (OLD.type IN ('NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED','NATIVE_COMMAND_FINISHED','NATIVE_COMMAND_RECOVERED')
   OR NEW.type IN ('NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED','NATIVE_COMMAND_FINISHED','NATIVE_COMMAND_RECOVERED'))
 AND (OLD.task_id IS NOT NEW.task_id OR OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.type IS NOT NEW.type
  OR (CASE WHEN OLD.type='NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED' THEN json_extract(OLD.payload_json,'$.ref')
      ELSE coalesce(json_extract(OLD.payload_json,'$.receipt.tool_call_ref'),json_extract(OLD.payload_json,'$.ref')) END)
   IS NOT (CASE WHEN NEW.type='NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED' THEN json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.ref')
      ELSE coalesce(json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.receipt.tool_call_ref'),json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.ref')) END))
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO runtime_open_commands_dirty VALUES(OLD.task_id) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO NOTHING;
 INSERT INTO runtime_open_commands_dirty VALUES(NEW.task_id) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO NOTHING;
END

name: runtime_open_commands_remove
runtime_open_commands_settle
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_open_commands_settle
AFTER INSERT ON runtime_events WHEN NEW.type IN ('NATIVE_COMMAND_FINISHED','NATIVE_COMMAND_RECOVERED')
BEGIN
 DELETE FROM runtime_open_commands WHERE task_id=NEW.task_id AND start_id<NEW.id
  AND command_ref=coalesce(json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.receipt.tool_call_ref'),json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.ref'));
END

name: runtime_open_commands_start
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER runtime_open_commands_start
AFTER INSERT ON runtime_events WHEN NEW.type='NATIVE_COMMAND_STARTED'
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO runtime_open_commands(task_id,start_id,command_ref)
 SELECT NEW.task_id,NEW.id,json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.ref')
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM runtime_events f WHERE f.task_id=NEW.task_id AND f.id>NEW.id
   AND f.type IN ('NATIVE_COMMAND_FINISHED','NATIVE_COMMAND_RECOVERED')
   AND coalesce(json_extract(f.payload_json,'$.receipt.tool_call_ref'),json_extract(f.payload_json,'$.ref'))=json_extract(NEW.payload_json,'$.ref')
 );
END

name: assignment_worktrees
sql:
CREATE TABLE assignment_worktrees (
 task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 assignment_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('provisioning','bound','integrating','integrated')),
 plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 witness_json TEXT,
 integrated_digest TEXT,
 integrated_event INTEGER,
 PRIMARY KEY(task_id,revision,assignment_ref),
 CHECK((state='provisioning')=(witness_json IS NULL)),
 CHECK((state='integrated')=(integrated_digest IS NOT NULL AND integrated_event IS NOT NULL))
)

name: code_editor_epoch

)

name: code_owner_file_active
sql:
CREATE INDEX code_owner_file_active ON code_owner_file_leases(epoch,expires_at)
 WHERE state='active'

name: code_owner_file_leases
sql:
CREATE TABLE code_owner_file_leases (
 record_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(record_version=1),
 checkout TEXT NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL,
 path TEXT NOT NULL, holder TEXT NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL,
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(token_hash)=64),
 acquired_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(acquired_generation>0),
 released_generation INTEGER CHECK(released_generation=acquired_generation+1),
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','released')),
 CHECK((state='active')=(released_generation IS NULL)),
 PRIMARY KEY(checkout,path)
)

name: code_writer_reservations

CREATE TABLE code_writer_reservations (

 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, checkout TEXT NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL,
 paths TEXT CHECK(paths IS NULL OR json_valid(paths)),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','ambiguous','released'))
)

name: fact_memory
sql:
CREATE TABLE fact_memory (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 assignment_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 path TEXT NOT NULL,
 sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256)=64),
 observation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(observation IN ('read','write')),
 failure TEXT CHECK(failure IN ('missing_access','owner_decision','other_role_work','tool_unavailable','check_failed','check_failure_unverified')),
 failed_check TEXT CHECK(json_type(failed_check)='object'),
 UNIQUE(task_id, assignment_ref, path, observation)
)

name: native_worktree_bound_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER native_worktree_bound_immutable
 BEFORE UPDATE OF project_id,actor_id,request_id,draft_id,draft_version,digest,
  intent_version,state,plan_json,witness_json,runtime_task_id,error_code ON native_worktree_starts
 WHEN OLD.state='bound' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable'); END

 BEFORE DELETE ON native_worktree_starts
 WHEN OLD.state='bound' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable'); END

name: native_worktree_starts
sql:
CREATE TABLE native_worktree_starts (
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 draft_id TEXT NOT NULL, draft_version INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 intent_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(intent_version=1),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','bound','failed-known','uncertain')),
 plan_json TEXT, witness_json TEXT, runtime_task_id TEXT UNIQUE, error_code TEXT,
 close_cleanup TEXT, purge_cleanup TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(project_id,actor_id,request_id)
)
